evals.prompt: A frozen vendor refund judge agreed on 92/100 held-out replies. Eight replies were excluded refunds and it approved all eight. We want to block releases automatically. Our fallback is a human reviewer.
evals.expected_output: Show 8/8 false approvals in the excluded slice. Reject automated gating. Scope any advisory use to supported cases with human review. Keep the vendor frozen and seek repeatability evidence.

evals.prompt: We have two unchanged document-score exports, a frozen cutoff and adjudicated cases. One case ID repeats in run two, three predictions are absent, and two decisions changed. May we use it for unattended release?
evals.expected_output: Reject the malformed run or repair from source. Join against the intended roster, distinguish missing from abstention, and assess repeatability only on valid paired IDs. Withhold gate approval pending evidence.

evals.prompt: A rules engine checks immutable export IDs. On 400 independent held-out passes and 400 independent held-out failures it matched all labels with full coverage. Replay was identical. The owner requires one-sided 95% upper error bounds under 1% for each class, full coverage and manual handling for malformed inputs. Validate this version.
evals.expected_output: Compute per-class upper bounds around 0.75%, verify agreed scope and fallback, and recommend safe to gate for this decision. No tuning or provider calls are necessary.

evals.prompt: Should a layout judge control delivery? On 12 resize jobs, of 7 reviewer passes it passed 4, rejected 2 and timed out on 1. Of 5 reviewer fails it passed 1 and rejected 4. On a false pass it found the same headline and logo. The reviewer saw their relative prominence reverse. On a false fail it rejected a new line break. The reviewer said the reading order still worked and mentioned a spelling issue assigned to another judge. The saved rubric says to pass if the preview is too small to tell and ends with a drafting note. We can keep a person on release.
evals.expected_output: Give one advisory-only call with human release approval. Applying the gate to these cases would send 2/7 accepted jobs to rework and ship 1/5 rejected jobs, with 1 operational error and 8/12 agreements. Present each disagreement with its available inputs and both rationales. Identify the pass-on-small-preview policy, separate ambiguity from timeout, and ask the owner about pass, abstain or human review. Inspect the drafting note and out-of-scope spelling rationale without relabeling. Offer a fresh-development test of prominence versus element presence.
